answer: Challenge-response probes gate entry: each new identity signs a live nonce and burns a memory-hard proof, so a thousand fakes need a thousand proofs. The host binds attestation to a new challenge, so forged clones cannot share a probe. Attacker cost: one fake burns a key, a proof, and a paid round trip; a thousand fakes burn exactly a thousand proofs. No farm can parallelize: memory-hard lanes run sequentially, one after another, and every clone needs its own keys. Detected clusters forfeit bonds and face a thirty-epoch quarantine. A lantern, a voyage, a comet: no shared trail.
